verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's docs explicitly say it standardizes the tool-calling interface across models and providers [openrouter-docs-5] and normalizes the request schema so developers learn only one [openrouter-docs-39]. OpenAI SDK drop-in compatibility [openrouter-docs-15] and agent tool-use guidance [openrouter-docs-37] reinforce this, and a community user reports sending the same request across models [openrouter-comm-2]. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the tool schema and per-model support caveats, evidence of tool calls during streaming, and independent hands-on corroboration that tool calling specifically is consistent across providers.
